The '''1943 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 41st staging of [[Copa del Rey]]. It was organized by the [[Royal Spanish Football Federation]]. There were a total of 32 teams participating. The competition began on 25 April 1943 and concluded on 20 June 1943 with the [[1943 Copa del Generalísimo Final|final]], where [[Athletic Bilbao]] won their 14th title.

==Semi-finals==
<ref name=rsf/>
{{TwoLegStart}}
{{TwoLegResult|[[FC Barcelona|CF Barcelona]]|| 4–11 |'''[[Real Madrid C.F.|Real Madrid]]'''||3–0| [[Real Madrid v FC Barcelona (1943 Copa del Generalísimo)|1–11]] |winner=2}} 
{{TwoLegResult|'''[[Athletic Bilbao|Atlético de Bilbao]]'''|| 3–2 |[[Valencia CF]]||  1–0 | 2–2 |winner=1}}
|}

Barcelona faced Real Madrid in the semi-finals of the 1943 Copa del Generalísimo. The first leg match, played at [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]]'s [[Camp de Les Corts|Les Corts]] stadium in [[Catalonia]], ended with Barcelona winning 3–0. On 13 June 1943, [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] [[Real Madrid v FC Barcelona (1943 Copa del Generalísimo)|beat Barcelona 11–1]] in the second leg, advancing to the final 11–4 on aggregate.<ref>"[https://books.google.com/books?id=2l6zHv_reuUC&pg=PA77 Sid Lowe: Fear and loathing in La Liga.. Barcelona vs Real Madrid]" Random House. 26 September 2013</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Real Madrid v Barcelona: six of the best 'El Clásicos'|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/la-liga/8946213/Real-Madrid-v-Barcelona-six-of-the-best-El-Clasicos.html|work=The Daily Telegraph|access-date=19 December 2011|date=9 December 2011|location=London|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111219102109/http://www.telegraph.co.uk/sport/football/competitions/la-liga/8946213/Real-Madrid-v-Barcelona-six-of-the-best-El-Clasicos.html|archive-date=2011-12-19|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=A brief history of the Spanish Cup clásico|url=http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/a-brief-hisotry-of-the-spanish-cup-clasico|date=22 December 2015|access-date=2015-12-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151223091709/http://www.fcbarcelona.com/football/first-team/detail/article/a-brief-hisotry-of-the-spanish-cup-clasico|archive-date=2015-12-23|url-status=dead}}</ref>
